prompts.brown: Use case: illustration. Create a high-quality finished tattoo flash illustration for a minimalist white resume website's narrow LEFT side gutter. Tall portrait canvas, approximately 1:3 proportions. One intricately detailed realistic human eye centered EXACTLY at 50% width and 50% height, horizontal almond eye, warm BROWN amber iris with extraordinarily intricate radial fibers, crypts, limbal ring, black pupil and tiny realistic white catchlights. Surround it above and below with a vertically elongated symmetrical fine-line black ink mandala, ornamental lotus petals, geometric lace, elegant stippling and delicate filigree. Thin charcoal lines, generous negative space, refined modern tattoo aesthetic, not a heavy dark slab. The eye is the focal point and fills about 80% of canvas width. Entire ornament fully inside canvas with small margins. White background, no skin, no face, no eyebrow, no text, no border, no UI mockup. Crisp engraving detail, elegant and quietly striking.
